content.text:
CI should be green now. All 7 tests pass, and I ran the suite 3 times with no failures.

**Cause:** The test wasn't flaky. It failed on every run. `store.list()` returned notes oldest-first, but the test `lists notes newest first` expects newest-first. The test name and the README both suggest newest-first is the intended behavior, so I fixed the store instead of the test.

**Fix:** In `/work/notes-api/src/store.js`, `list()` now returns `[...notes].reverse()`. It orders by insertion order rather than `createdAt`, so notes added in the same millisecond still sort correctly.

**Behavior change to check before you ship:** `GET /notes` and `/admin/stats` both call `list()`. The notes endpoint will now return the newest notes first. If any client relies on the old oldest-first order, it will see a difference. The admin stats only count notes and tags, so they are unaffected. If you'd rather keep the old API order, say so and I'll revert the store change and fix the test expectation instead.

I haven't committed anything.
